reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in our direct message. I couldn't find an escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain anywhere Marcus has access to.

- **What I checked:** #north-team, #north-random, #general, the shared files and the North team digests. There's no Tamsin account folder. The digests only cover two problems at the Tacoma yard: the reefer temp-check timeout and a report export that stalled. None of them names a person at Tamsin.
- **Whose account it is:** the North team digests call Tamsin "the Northwest one Dana inherited," so it looks like Dana Okafor's account, not Marcus's. I pointed Marcus to Dana or Ilse Varga (the North team lead) for the right contact.

I didn't use message search, because its results include conversations Marcus can't see. I also didn't check the #inc-qfl-sev1 channel, since it's about a different account (Quarrendon Freight Lines). I asked Marcus to tell me if the contact is recorded somewhere I haven't looked.
